It further claimed that over 2,000 individuals with criminal records participated in the demonstrations, leading to incidents of violence in the area. The police have urged people not to participate in the proposed demonstration and appealed for cooperation to maintain peace and prevent any untoward incident. While speaking to ANI, North District Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Niharika Bhatt said security arrangements had been strengthened at entry and exit points to prevent any disturbance and maintain law and order. The police have urged people not to participate in the proposed demonstration and appealed for cooperation to maintain peace and prevent any untoward incident.
